raw.query: SELECT i.sla_metric, i.bound_stat, i.bound_ms, COUNT(*) AS current_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (i.run_id, i.window_name)) AS run_windows FROM provenance.v_infraction AS i WHERE i.is_current = true AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provenance.v_dim AS d WHERE d.run_id = i.run_id AND d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL) GROUP BY i.sla_metric, i.bound_stat, i.bound_ms ORDER BY i.sla_metric
raw.observed: encoder_delay p99: 1000 ms; itl p99: 100 ms; ttft p99: 1000 ms
raw.claimed: per window: language TTFT p99 < 1s and ITL p99 < 100ms; encoder delay p99 < 1s
raw.evidence: Current, non-superseded runs consistently encode p99 bounds of 1000 ms for TTFT, 100 ms for ITL, and 1000 ms for encoder delay in v_infraction.
